characters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: single cosmetic wizard character-selection portrait for Wizard Combat. Reference image: the existing two wizard portraits, used for rendering style, lighting, costume detail, and wand-ready pose only. Create ONE new character, never a pair or sheet. Single portrait canvas, waist-up, entire head and hair with clear top margin, shoulders and both elbows fit inside frame; crop only at lower waist. Three-quarter body facing slightly toward screen RIGHT, face turned toward screen right, wand held diagonally across chest with a small restrained cyan tip glow. One wooden wand, natural five-fingered hands. Fully transparent background, clean silhouette, no scenery, no UI, no letters, no name, no logo, no frame, no checkerboard. Outfit should be readable at small size. Create a distinctly new identity rather than recoloring the existing face. Rowan, the Duelist: adult man about 30, warm medium olive skin, short straight black hair with closely trimmed sides (not the reference's wavy hair), angular face, broad nose, clean shaven, calm focused gaze. Fitted midnight navy dueling coat, restrained aged-gold seams, dark teal inner collar, worn brown leather belt visible at waist; practical sharp silhouette, no armor.
characters.cleanupPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit this exact character portrait. Preserve the character's exact face, hair, clothes, hands, wand, pose, colors and details. Remove ALL studio background, ALL smoky colored haze, ALL background gradient and ALL broad light bloom outside the actual character silhouette. Output this same character as a genuinely clean transparent PNG cutout, empty alpha=0 everywhere outside character except tiny localized wand-tip glow. Keep the portrait's existing crop and size. No background replacement color, no checkerboard, no changes to identity, no text. The fuzzy grey-blue/red halo surrounding the person must disappear completely. This is an asset extraction, not a new character.
